# Lucian Icons (vendored)

https://lucianlabs.dev/icons/ · https://github.com/Seokwoooo/lucian-icons — v2.0.13, MIT License (LICENSE).

Only the icon modules this app uses, copied unchanged from `skills/lucian-icons/code/` with their shared `runtime.js`.
The Lucian / lucianLabs names and logo are not used (see the project TRADEMARKS.md).
Colors follow the app theme through `--li-accent` · `--li-tint` (src/themes.css).
